import numpy as np
import textwrap

RATIOS = [
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'', ''Leverage_Ratio'', ''ROA'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'', ''CurrentAssets_Ratio'',
    ''MarketValue_Liabilities'', ''Log_TotalAssets''
]
LABEL = {
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'':         ''Thanh toan hien hanh (TSNH / No NH)'',
    ''Leverage_Ratio'':          ''Tong no / Tong TS'',
    ''ROA'':                     ''ROA (LN rong / Tong TS)'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'': ''LN giu lai / Tong TS'',
    ''CurrentAssets_Ratio'':     ''TS ngan han / Tong TS'',
    ''MarketValue_Liabilities'': ''log10(Von hoa / Tong no)'',
    ''Log_TotalAssets'':         ''log10(Tong tai san)'',
}
HEAVY = [''Liquidity_Ratio'', ''Leverage_Ratio'', ''ROA'', ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'']

# --- Bang mau do dam ---
RED_BOX    = ''#cb181d''   # nen hop
RED_MEDIAN = ''#67000d''   # vach trung vi (do dam nhat)
RED_EDGE   = ''#99000d''   # vien hop / rau
RED_FLIER  = ''#99000d''   # cham ngoai lai
INK        = ''#252525''

def wrap(t, w=22):
    return ''\n''.join(textwrap.wrap(t, w))

    s = dataset[c].dropna()
    if len(s) == 0:
        ax.set_visible(False)
        continue
    ax.boxplot(
        s, widths=0.55, whis=1.5, patch_artist=True,
        flierprops=dict(marker=''o'', markersize=2.5,
                        markerfacecolor=RED_FLIER, markeredgecolor=''none'',
                        alpha=0.4),
        boxprops=dict(facecolor=RED_BOX, edgecolor=RED_EDGE, lw=1.0),
        medianprops=dict(color=RED_MEDIAN, lw=2.2),
        whiskerprops=dict(color=RED_EDGE, lw=1.0),
        capprops=dict(color=RED_EDGE, lw=1.0),
    )
    if c in HEAVY:
        ax.set_yscale(''symlog'', linthresh=1)
    ax.set_xticks([])

    ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=''#eeeeee'', lw=0.8)
